content.text: The preserve→seat POST gets a 405 and preserve then returns 500, so the preserve outbound call looks like the fault. Before settling on that, I'll compare normal vs abnormal span counts, 5xx rates and latency per service to check whether other services changed on their own.

input.query: SELECT p, service_name, count(*) spans, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) p95ms FROM (SELECT 'normal' p, * FROM normal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', * FROM abnormal_traces) WHERE attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

input.reflection: Findings: only ts-preserve-service (806 of 807 server spans erroring, all POST /preserve 500) and ts-ui-dashboard (38 errors, 500s from preserve) show errors. Preserve's outbound POST to ts-seat-service gets 405; seat logs 'Request method GET not supported' and its server span is GET /error, so the method was rewritten on preserve's outgoing call. Fault kind: http_response_body_corrupted at ts-preserve-service (method/path rewritten). Other shifts (basic rss, security class loaded, order-other logs) are not tied to errors. Propagation: preserve -> ui-dashboard. Ready to answer.
